svg.title: a & (a - 1) clears the lowest set bit of 12
svg.desc: a = 12 is 00001100, a - 1 = 11 is 00001011: the lowest 1 of a (position 2) and everything below it flips. a & (a - 1) = 8 is 00001000: the lowest 1 cleared, positions 3 to 7 kept.
svg.text: positions 7..3 agree in a and a − 1, so AND keeps them
